image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a marine fish, identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays a laterally compressed, disc-shaped body. The coloration features a distinct black anterior section covering the head and front torso, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior section and tail. The scales are visible with a textured pattern. The dorsal and anal fins are prominent, extending towards the tail which appears rounded. The background is a blurred blue aquatic environment with hints of coral or rock structures.

The caudal fin (tail) has a rounded edge, consistent with the species description.
